issues.display_title: Issue #1714: Optional save_only Passthrough on AI Blur to blur_requests
issues.main_description_html:
• Endpoint: POST /tours/ai-blur — existing route, new optional request field

Context

The AI blur flow currently always publishes each panorama to the downstream blur engine (blur_requests queue) for the full blur + publish pipeline. Some callers need the blur to run and the result to be persisted only, without the downstream consumer publishing it.

A new optional save_only boolean lets the client request that. It is optional and defaults to false, so every existing caller is unaffected. The flag is forwarded unchanged through the whole chain — API request → ai_blur queue → per-pano blur_requests message — and the downstream blur_requests consumer decides what to do with it.

Naming follows each boundary's existing convention: snake_case save_only in the public request body and the blur_requests payload; camelCase saveOnly in the internal ai_blur payload.

Request field

Field Type Required Default Meaning
save_only boolean no false When true, forwarded downstream so the blur is persisted only, not published

Payload shape

ai_blur queue (internal, camelCase):

{
  "tokens": [],
  "panos": [101, 102],
  "userId": 55,
  "moderationId": 900,
  "aiBlurBudget": 2,
  "type": "face",
  "saveOnly": false
}

blur_requests queue (one message per pano, snake_case):

{
  "pano_id": 101,
  "types": ["face"],
  "save_only": false
}

Acceptance criteria

  • POST /tours/ai-blur accepts an optional save_only boolean in the request body
  • Omitting save_only, or sending false, keeps the current behavior exactly (backward compatible)
  • The flag is forwarded unchanged into the ai_blur queue payload as saveOnly
  • The flag is forwarded unchanged into every blur_requests message as save_only, on both the free-credit and paid-token pano paths
  • Test coverage for both the default false and the true case in the published payload

Note

The blur_requests consumer lives outside this repository. It must read save_only (treating a missing key as false) to actually act on it — this task only forwards the flag.

Result

Implemented in PR #1713 — save_only threaded end-to-end (default false):

  • AIBlurDto parses save_only from the body
  • AIBlurAction passes it to the queue service
  • AIBlurQueueService adds saveOnly to the ai_blur payload
  • ai_blur worker forwards save_only into every blur_requests message (free + paid paths)
  • Tests cover both false (default) and true in the published payload — suite green (9/9)
